status_legend.documented: stated in the vendor's public docs
status_legend.public-tool: relied on by a public open-source parser (CodexBar, ccusage); not checked against vendor docs
status_legend.assumed: compactlab's own reading; needs verification against real files with the user's approval
status_legend.public-source: read from the harness's own open-source code, docs or test snapshots; not yet checked against a user's real logs

usage_fields.value: message.usage.{input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, output_tokens} on assistant lines

dedupe.value: streamed responses repeat; key = message.id + requestId

compact_boundary.value: type=system, subtype=compact_boundary, compactMetadata.preTokens; next user line isCompactSummary=true holds the summary

parent_session.value: parentSessionId on lines of resumed/forked sessions

latency_proxy.value: turn latency = assistant line timestamp minus the last user/tool_result line timestamp; the first content block of a streamed response is kept

compaction_latency_proxy.value: compact_boundary timestamp minus the last input line before it

default_threshold.value: ~967K for native-1M models; 200K for Sonnet/Opus 4.6 without extended context; else the context limit

line_shape.value: {timestamp, type, payload}; types session_meta, turn_context, event_msg, response_item, compacted

token_counts.value: event_msg/token_count: info.total_token_usage is cumulative, info.last_token_usage is per request; snapshots are re-emitted

fork_lineage.value: session_meta.forked_from_id; subagent source {subagent: ...} or "subagent"; copied parent prefix may embed ancestor session_meta and a zero-usage opening snapshot

replay_end.value: copied ancestor history ends at the next turn_context

compact_setting.value: top-level model_auto_compact_token_limit (number) in config.toml; global, not per model

latency_proxy.value: token_count timestamp minus the last user_message / function_call_output timestamp

default_limit.value: 90% of the resolved context window; configured values clamped to it

generations.value: one file per format generation; the highest vN (no suffix = 0) is current

compression.value: .jsonl.zstd = concatenated independent zstd frames (header frame, then one per append batch); plain .jsonl when persistenceCompression is 'none'; a torn last frame is truncated

line_shape.value: header {type:'session', version, id, createdAt, cwd?, parentSession?, origin?:'subagent', isSeeded, delegationDepth}; events {type, seq, time (epoch ms), data}

token_counts.value: assistant/message data.usage {inputTokens (uncached), cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens, outputTokens, reasoningTokens?}; counts are disjoint, billed input = the sum of the first three

reasoning_in_output.value: reasoningTokens is assumed to be included in outputTokens (DeepSeek completion_tokens includes reasoning)

fork_lineage.value: seeded forks (isSeeded) copy parent events up to session/end-seed; subagents have origin 'subagent' and parentSession

row_time.value: rows carry time (epoch ms); when absent, the latest provider-stream chunk time of an assistant/message is used

compact_setting.value: dsh-compaction-basic: thresholdRatio (0.8), headroomTokens (65536), modelPolicies[]; trigger = min(window x ratio, window - reserved output - headroom)

config_location.value: where a user's plugin config lives (profile patch / cordis.yml under $DSH_HOME) is not verified; apply does not write it
